title: Flame typography film

location.series: JKR / Burger King identity case study
location.extent: Complete clip; PNG is a poster frame

slide_intent: Use the movement of letters to reinforce their tone so typography can communicate appetite as well as words.
strategic_value: Large rounded forms and changing scale can give Burger King’s verbal character a distinctive moving expression.
demonstration: The film sequences large food words, typeface identification, repeated phrases, close crops of glyphs and a closing Have It Your Way lockup.
practical_value: Compare repetition, scale and glyph detail as ways to animate an established type family.

content_islands.name: Word sequence
content_islands.spec: Open with a large Eat specimen and move through short phrases and font labels.

content_islands.name: Texture and detail
content_islands.spec: Repeat tasty and gooey words, vary scale and crop into rounded letterforms.

content_islands.name: Signature ending
content_islands.spec: Resolve the animation into the Have It Your Way phrase on red.

reference_purposes.Expression: The clip uses food words, repetition, shifting scale and letterform close-ups to express the type system.
